original: So the whole sinful crew is on board?
Heh... It was entertaining at first, but it caused quite a mess.
Still... good luck with what comes next.
Oh! You startled me... Yes, they've all agreed.
I just need to get the last portal fragment.
And to get it, I'll have to face the other me.
Well, I suppose I'll help you. To be honest, I'm not very fond of your other version.
It seems you're the better choice. But who can really know, right?
You never explained why you split us in the first place.
That's... complicated. The kind of complicated that only gods enjoy. But in short, I wanted to try something different.
Like when I decided humans were ready to handle things on their own.
Hey guys... how's your project going?
Something elegant, maybe carved from expensive wood. With a paper holder.
We'd be very grateful. Right, Jack?
Yes... the readers adore me. They write such wonderful letters.
Alright then. If that's what you need, I'll make it.
Well... it's...
Great... just great. We're still in the pre-production phase.
Yes, we're planning to make some money first, and then travel around studying how other colossi were built.
Maybe you should start building your own first.
You know... that might actually be a good idea.
Did you lose your fan letters again?
Looks like I did...
Keeper, you could really help us by crafting a new prosthetic hand for Jack.
I hope today we'll finally do something.
Not right now. I'm starting a new project instead.
A brand new magazine... OnlyFuns. Linda will write about all the funny stories from the Port Club.
It's going to be a huge success!
Ah, here's the letters...
Wow... people really like me. These letters are full of compliments.
I told you.
Hey, yesterday we released the twelfth issue of our magazine.
We shared all our grand plans with the readers!
Plans are nice... but maybe we should actually build something too.
Jack, everyone is thrilled about your vision for the colossus.
We sold twice as many copies as usual. Where's that adoring fan letter?
Wait... there's new letters?
A whole pile of them!
That's wonderful. You were also planning to publish your poetry, remember?
Elegant hand
Here's an elegant hand for you. It won't hold a hammer, but it's perfect for holding papers.
Thanks, Keeper. It's exactly what I needed.
What's wrong? You were shouting in your sleep.
Just a strange dream. My friends were heading down the wrong path.
Maybe that's the sign you were waiting for. They might need your help!
Comfortable chair
Here it is — the most comfortable chair I could come up with.
Say thank you, Herbert.
Yes, yes... of course. Thank you, Keeper!
Hello... how's everything going?
He can build the most comfortable chair for you... right?
Yes... of course. That won't be a problem.
Very peaceful... though my legs seem to be getting weaker.
Don't worry. We'll get you a new chair... something more comfortable.
Maybe what you need is more walking.
You might be right. I was even thinking of returning to my old post... just part-time.
That's nonsense, with your condition.
Do you want me to just leave you be... and deliver your body to the Keeper?
No, no, Agatha... there's still so many books you can read to me.
That's the right attitude, Herbert. And our friend the Keeper will be happy to help us.
Are you sure you don't need anything?
And then I'll have a part of you forever.
Alright, Agatha... I'd hate to upset you.
No, you just sit and relax. You're safe here... don't wear yourself out.
I'll be back soon, and read to you some more.
That sounds terrific. Meanwhile, maybe I'll take a short walk... visit my old guards.
Absolutely not. They're a terrible influence on you.
My life has become too calm. I'm starting to think you're protecting me a little too much...
I just don't want to lose you, Herbert. I've already lost so much.
Now relax and think of the next story you're going to tell me.
The Keeper's device will write it down.
Bad dream, Keeper?
Yes... not a pleasant one. A disturbing dream about my friends.
Maybe it's time for you to help them.
Hey Albert how are you doing?
You deserve it, my love. Do you need something, Keeper?
Actually yes. I'm looking for a way to help you. Maybe you can think of something.
Do you need any help, Linda?
Oh, that's very sweet of you...
We're fine. Everything is under control. But if you want to help, you could bring me some luxury drapes.
Water-resistant drapes. I want to decorate my basement lab.
Hmm, yes Albert... drapes would make it look much nicer.
Alright, I'll try to make some for you.
Good, good, Keeper. Quite busy, but very happy.
Where's Linda? She's usually welcoming patrons around this time.
She's resting. She has done so much for the town... she deserves some personal time now.
Of course you're right, Albert.
Oh... I overslept, darling.
Nice to see you, Keeper... yawn
Hi Linda... you look different.
Albert is wrapping me with care... maybe a bit too tightly.
Luxury drapes.
I brought the drapes. They're waterproof and fire-resistant.
Thank you, Keeper. That's exactly what we needed to make our little nest even nicer.
Linda — I was waiting for you downstairs in my lab!
The basement is quieter. Much better for delicate work.
You'll grow to appreciate it soon.
I'll appreciate anything you do for me, my love.
Oh sorry, darling. I was busy and lost track of time.
I gave you a weekly schedule for a reason. You need to stop working so much.
It's time for your health injection. I've prepared several serums for you.
Oh Albert... maybe you've already taken enough care of me.
Nonsense. Your beauty and health must be preserved. Afterward you'll rest... a long, deep sleep.
Of course, Albert... I'm just not used to someone caring about me so much.
You are everything to me... and your health and beauty deserve protection.
But why can't we do the procedure in your medical office upstairs?
Something's happening, isn't it?
Yes, something is always happening... you just need to have fun with it.
I think it's time for you to have fun helping others.
Bridge to the Lake.
She's so kind... and fragile in her own way. She misses her sisters deeply.
Maybe "fragile" isn't quite the right word.
You should have seen her eyes, when she mentioned the organ from her old monastery.
I asked Jack... He said you'd be able to build one.
Let me guess... It needs special wood for proper resonance.
So you've already looked into it.
Then it's fortunate you're heading to the woodcarvers anyway.
Yes, that's a lucky coincidence.
Let me know when the organ is ready.
We need a plan to fight through to the woodcarvers on the lake.
You're never content with peace, are you...
I was even considering leaving the service... and yet here you are again.
Herbert, trust me... this time it benefits you too.
Fine. We'll push north from the square, cross the two main bridges...
Then head west. That should lead us to the lake bridge... if it's not overrun.
Sounds like a plan...
Wait... this might also be my chance to repay Agatha.
Still Standing on Stilts
Leaving the service.
So? Everyone has their flaws.
All I need is a proper suit of armor to mount on the wall... and then I'll retire.
That I can provide.
And maybe a set for my men...
So I know they'll be protected once I step aside.
That sounds doable.
Are you really planning to step down?
Why not? Things are finally stable.
And I should spend more time with Agatha... it steadies her.
You're right. She shouts at people less.
Exactly. And your soldiers are stronger than ever.
There's a new quartermaster replacing Jack at the warehouse.
He's stubborn, and a creature of few words. He'll go far... and he'd be a great replacement for me, too.
But he's a Ram.
So... the legendary magic portal is nearly finished.
Alright... it's in a well-secured, heavily protected inquisitor base.
One of the inquisitors had quite a pretty wife, so during my last job I kept an eye on them.
Hold on... the base on the hill west of Town?
Maybe. I can see the place, but I don't have a map.
And it's still guarded? When did you last check?
Some time ago... but I'm quite sure... Wait... where did all the inquisitors go?
Now I just see a funny donkey drinking with... a talking skull.
Then that's definitely my base. Where's the fragment?
Just lying around in the debris.
Well... that sounds surprisingly easy.
Yes. Two more fragments, and the thing should finally work again.
Just let me know when you're placing the final piece.
I'd like to be standing very far away from any dramatic portal activation.
That's reasonable... ha ha.
Mirror, mirror... show me the sixth portal fragment.
Let's see... the sixth one...
Oh dear... that one won't be easy. Especially for a couple shady fellows with a magic mirror.
Just tell him! He'll get it no matter the cost.
Got it.
Hmm... except you're dressed differently. And the other skull looks better.
Excuse me? The other talking skull?
Ah yes, and there, I see her — the Keeper's wife. She told me to call her the Queen.
Where are they?
In the throne room of the Royal Palace. The last fragment is there.
That's bad news. The palace is in the center of the infected area.
But I also have good news.
What's the good news?
I just won a bet against Comrade Donkey. I said we'd eventually need to meet your other self.
I just need that fragment, not to meet myself.
Is that the last fragment?
We won't tell donkey about that part.
There is somebody who'd know the way to the Palace.
Who is that?
Davy the Dagger. He knows all the hidden paths. Talk to him.
No, I still need one more.
That's good. You know — as your friend and companion, I'm expecting a wish for myself.
Of course, Larry. We're almost there.
I'll ask where the last fragment is right away.
Mirror, mirror... reveal the final portal fragment.
Hey... are you messing with me? You're standing right next to it with that talking skull.
No... this can't be the last one. Or is there another one here?
Even More Portal Parts
About the Palace...
I need a safe path to the throne room in the Royal Palace.
Wow, that is dangerous... Robbing the palace would be the crown jewel of my career!
See? I knew it was too much for you.
Hold on now! Anything is possible for the right price.
I swear I'll find that path. I'd gladly sacrifice every one of my looters to discover it.
And when they're gone, I'll recruit and train new ones!
That's the spirit. I admire your dedication, Davy.
There's nobody I can ask but you.
I'm listening.
Although... maybe this one is too hard for you.
Just get to the point.
It's probably just too dangerous...
Nothing is too dangerous for Davy the Dagger.
I'm not so sure...
Oh sard, just say what you want already.
Palace Politics
Keeper! This has been a job worth bragging about.
There should be a hidden door somewhere in this wall.
But even with all your strength and resources... it might just be too much.
Thanks, Davy. I'll figure something out.
Did you hear that, Larry? What should I do?
Looks like we're preparing for the final battle.
It's about time for your friends indeed to become your friends in need.
Care to be more specific?
Ask your friends for help.
I'm already asking them to help activate the portal.
Great. Then one more small favor shouldn't make any difference.
So you found a safe route?
Well... not exactly safe. You'll still need to fight your way through.
That's something I'm used to by now.
You don't understand. This fight will be massive.
You'll go in through the sewer, and come out at the square near the palace.
That's where you'll have to battle all the zombies in the area and keep them busy.
If you can hold them there, the road to the palace should stay open.
Look here... I brought a map to explain it.
Pay the amount.
Give me a day or two. I'll come to your house when I have news.
Wow... that's good service, Davy.
Nice, right? Only for our best customers.
Gunter even suggested that we offer every fifth looting for free.
Yeah, that sounds like something Gunther would come up with.
Gluttony and Pride
I need your help
But things could get much worse at any moment.
We need to restore balance to the world.
Looks pretty balanced to me.
Well, a fairy and an ancient goddess of nature wouldn't lie!
Would they?
Who knows what the ancient gods would or wouldn't do.
Maybe... but if you help me, we can all ask the magic portal for a wish.
You should've started with that. What do we need to do?
I just need you to stand beside me when I place the last fragment for the portal.
That's not a problem, right Jack?
My friends... I need to ask you something important.
But the last fragment is in the Palace... and I'll have to fight my way there.
Even with my factory and all my resources, I'll need every bit of help I can get.
It's no problem, Gunter. The portal is right behind the wall. We'll be there when the time comes.
And I might have something that will help you get that last fragment.
A scroll?
It's a blueprint for an automatic bow system. I never had enough resources to build a prototype.
But I bet you could make plenty of them.
Thanks, my friends.
We've been through a lot together. We've built a lot...
But it could all be for nothing, unless you help me save the world.
What's happening to the world, mate?
Well... zombies are flooding the Town, the days of the week are changing places...
I thought we reached a comfortable balance with the zombies.
And the strange calendar? It's just funny pictures. I'm already used to it.
Yeah, yeah... I know. I got used to it too...
Small printing press
I made this one simple to operate, Gunter.
Don't worry. Jack will help me figure it out.
The first thing I'm printing is the news that I finally have a printing press!
Prosthetic hand
Now this is exactly the prosthetic I needed!
I'm glad I could help with your project.
Writing device
I tested it, and surprisingly — it works!
That's because you're a good person... the gods' favorite Keeper.
Wrath and Sloth
I need your help
No, this is real. I need to complete the magic portal, stop the zombies, and help the Old God.
Shame on you... that sounds like old beliefs and superstitions.
You know, Agatha... the Keeper has earned my trust.
You'll easily see it's all true... and if you help me, you can each ask the portal for a wish.
We already have everything we need... but Herbert is right. You've earned our trust. We'll help you.
What do we need to do?
Stand beside me when I gather all the portal fragments.
I'll assemble them at the Astrologer's house by the port.
I don't much like that fellow... but we'll be there.
Thank you. The trouble is, the final fragment is in the Palace... and I'll have to fight my way in.
I know you've finally found some peace.
With all the faith and blessings in the world... plus my army... I'll still need your help to succeed.
But what can an old nun do?
Hmm... I bet the old head of the guard can do something.
I'll talk to the quartermaster.  I bet he can find some extra space for your defensive equipment.
And the mercenaries owe me a favor... You can use them in this battle.
The only thing I have to give you is my blessing, Keeper.
Thank you... it means a lot.
You've fought enough battles in your life.
But all of it could be meaningless, unless you help me save the world.
I know my prayers aren't enough... I'll have to teach Herbert how to pray properly!
Prayers may help... but this is bigger than that. The very foundation of the world is in danger.
And I'm the only one who can save it... with your help, of course.
Oh, I see what this is. He's rehearsing the dramatic part from his trilogy.
He's not bad, I have to admit. Very heroic tone.
Trilogy
Wow, they look amazing. I bet they're very exciting.
You're right, Herbert... great books always have great covers.
Bottles
Keeper, you've become a true craftsman. These bottles are truly elegant.
I'm glad they meet your standards, Albert.
Chocolate
Mmm... it smells wonderful. I can't wait to try it with Albert.
I'm sure you'll both enjoy it.
Lust and Envy
I need your help
I'm close to repairing that portal, but I still need to activate it.
For it to work, the two of you must stand beside me.
I don't get it... Are we going to travel somewhere through it?
No, the magic portal grants wishes... we'll all ask for one.
Pardon me, but I thought the main purpose of a portal was traveling.
It's a rather strange for such an object to be granting wishes.
Albert, don't be so skeptical. You could ask the portal for a cure for Aleksta.
Ah... you're right. Portal or not, we'll help you.
But the last fragment is in the Palace, and I'll have to fight my way there.
Even with an army of my best zombies, I don't have enough strength to win that battle.
Linda, Albert... I have something important to ask.
Say no more. In my research, I happened across a potion formula.
It makes zombie skin much stronger. It should help you.
That's wonderful work, Albert. As for me, all I have is a recipe that greatly boosts endurance.
I've taken it many times myself.
Thank you. Now I feel much more prepared.
Just when you've finally found happiness together, the whole world may be in danger.
The world is teetering on the edge of non-existence...
Oh no... I knew things were too good to be true.
Did you hear that, Linda? Apparently, the end of the world has terrible timing.
Let him talk, Albert. The Keeper probably has a plan.
That's right. Everything that's happening... the zombie problem and all of it...
It all started because of the previous Keeper and a magic portal.
Tower laboratory
So what was this laboratory used for?
So what was the laboratory upstairs used for?
Of course, you just get stuff like this handed to you... If only I had a table like that when I was young and curious.
Misguided inquisitor alchemy, I guess... cough-cough
Not much left now... except that table in the middle.
Oh... and of course they left behind the most valuable equipment.
It’s a Survey Table... you use it to learn things about items.
That knowledge is supposed to enrich your understanding of the world... cough-cough.
Wait... any item can give me knowledge?
Well, in your case I couldn't be sure... but in general, yes. It can even show some of an item's alchemy properties.
Seems like a very important table. I’ll get a lot of use out of it.
Go Wild in the Wild Lands
Get Royal Pardon
To receive a Royal Pardon, you must first commit a minor crime.
Well, that I can do.
Minor crime detected... damage to Royal property.
Pay the fine to receive a Royal Pardon.
Refill the ink.
Royal Pardon granted.
Pay the fine
Fine paid. Thank you for your cooperation.
Royal box is out of black ink.
Give fish.
Those fish look delicious.
Honestly, they look pretty unappetizing to me.
Nonsense... you just need to know how to cook them!
Here... try these recipes. Might change your mind.
The Quiet Art
Ha ha... go on, take a look. I bet it's just what you need.
I couldn’t help noticing that little spark of madness in your eyes.
You think so? You are a talking skull, after all... Are you even real?
Oh, great... here we go.
I'm just saying you need some ways to relax... try some good food, drink some wine.
Heh... maybe you’re right, Larry... I do like this new life...
It’s just... sometimes what I have to do feels a little too strange.
Funny how the dust recipe turned out to be the easiest one.
Yeah... except I have no idea where to get those ingredients.
Hmm... you see that chest over there? Maybe it already has everything you need.
Yeah, sure... because life is always so convenient.
You’d be surprised... Sometimes it is — especially for desperate Keepers.
So, I see you’re doing pretty well helping the Town.
Yeah, yeah... I’m just a humble donkey trying to earn a carrot.
Yeah... those people need someone to look after them.
And naturally, that someone is you.
It's nice to feel like I'm needed... you know?
Yeah, yeah... but do they actually need your help?
I think they do.
I’m not so sure... those capitalist bastards got exactly what they deserved.
They did everything they could to drag the town into chaos.
Hey, I thought you moved past all that.
Three carrots a day, Comrade Donkey, one two okay!
Excuse me?
They don't make anything. The town is full of traders and shops... nothing but buying and selling.
But I get it... the worse the people — the better the corpses!
Hmm... I guess that’s one way to look at it.
Don’t worry about it. We’re all doing just fine.
La la la...
Good to see you in such a good mood.
You know, Larry isn't half bad... not as good as the last skull, but still.
I taught him how to drink. Ha ha...
And we scared the life out of the Nun...
Larry was riding me, and we were singing songs... ha ha.
I guess it’s good you're having a good time. If it doesn't affect your job, of course.
Hey... who makes all the beer we drink? Who's the one spoiling the town?
How goes the day, master of the Town?
You always talk in riddles.
Anyway, it’s a fine day for a donkey to work for your monopoly.
Me? I’m just a humble Graveyard Keeper.
Yeah... who happens to own the town.
Without you, this place would fall apart.
You’re being dramatic... They have a Town Head and... other important people.
Ha ha... still, a dark hat and a red eye would suit you nicely.
What are you talking about?
There was one guy a long time ago who did everything for these people.
Didn’t end well... ha ha.
